rows.note: Use it in compounds such as 勝出幅度 for a lead or 誤差幅度 for a permissible difference.

example.english: Our margin in this match isn't very big, so they could still catch up.
example.traditional: 今場比賽我哋領先幅度唔算大，仲有機會俾人追返上嚟。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 ling5 sin1 fuk1 dou6 m4 syun3 daai6 zung6 jau5 gei1 wui6 bei2 jan4 zeoi1 faan2 soeng5 lai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the proportion of selling price that is profit, especially in business contexts.

example.english: The margin on this product is too low, so it isn't worth selling.
example.traditional: 呢件貨嘅利潤率太低，賣多幾多都唔化算。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 fo3 ge3 lei6 jeon6 leot2 taai3 dai1 maai6 do1 gei2 do1 dou1 m4 faa3 syun3

rows.note: Use this for the blank edge of a printed page where notes may be written.

example.english: Please write your comments in the margin.
example.traditional: 請喺頁邊寫低你嘅意見。
example.jyutping: ceng2 hai2 jip6 bin1 se2 dai1 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3
